ownership: These detailed tests are agent-owned validation criteria for the selected complex concept, not extra requester definitions, exclusions, anchors, or hard visual obligations.
overall_rule: PASS only when an actual native image file is returned, viewed directly, and both agent-selected electrical phenomena satisfy E01-E04. Report other criteria separately and distinguish technical preflight, native pixels and user preference. A preview-only tool return is native_file_absent, never a pixel PASS.

tests.criterion: The same image visibly contains an air-gap electrical spark and sustained luminous gas inside a glass tube, recognized from pixels rather than prompt metadata.

A small blue-white irregular bright channel visibly spans the air gap between two metal electrodes with each end meeting a facing metal surface. Floating lightning decoration or ordinary reflected light fails.
Continuous orange-red emission follows the narrow curved glass tube bore and stays visually inside the glass carrier; a free-floating orange line or unrelated neon signage fails.
The brief blue-white air channel and continuous orange-red tube glow are separated in source, space, shape and color; the viewer can tell their carriers apart.
Metal terminals, glass tube wall, electrode caps, insulating mounts and power leads visibly connect the luminous phenomena to electrical apparatus; only those actually visible count.

The face remains recognizable as a close appearance reference: slender oval face, large almond gray-brown eyes, natural brows, softly full lips, short dark bob and wispy bangs. Describe similarity at the rendered scale without claiming identity proof.
The woman's hands and forearms have coherent ownership, relaxed reach and separation; the left hand rests on the console, while the right hand plausibly grasps the pencil above the logbook.

At least two visible restoration/use traces among removed collar, newly fitted collar, spare tube, logbook and travelling case connect to the apparatus, and the woman's directed attention links her to the test. Report richer imagined story separately.
The electrical carriers and reference face remain resolved together in a photographic scene; ambient practical light does not overwhelm the two emission sources.

precore_boundary_record: Only current user envelope, current reference observation, exact SKILL and named neutral precore files were used; no candidate, profile, index, research asset, test fixture, maintenance evidence or other arm was read.
